qs.q: In MS Word, a user applies a 'Heading 1' style to a paragraph. What is the primary benefit of this action?
o: It allows inclusion in the Table of Contents.
It increases the font size to 14 points.
It changes the paragraph alignment to center.
It adds a border around the text paragraph.
It converts the paragraph into a hyperlink.
qs.e: Heading styles are recognized by Word's navigation pane and Table of Contents generator.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: A student is writing a research paper and needs to cite a source. Which feature in MS Word automatically generates a bibliography?
o: The Insert tab using header sections.
The Mailings tab using envelope options.
The References tab using citation tools.
The Review tab using tracking changes.
The View tab using layout options.
qs.e: Word's reference manager tracks citations and compiles them into a formatted bibliography list.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: In MS Word, a user wants to insert a page break before a new chapter. Which key combination is standard?
o: Pressing Ctrl + Shift + P for section.
Pressing Ctrl + Enter to insert break.
Pressing Alt + Enter for line break.
Pressing Ctrl + B for page border.
Pressing Shift + Tab to indent text.
qs.e: Ctrl+Enter is the standard shortcut for forcing a page break in Word documents.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: In MS Word, a user wants to create a table of contents. What prerequisite is necessary?
o: The document must contain at least one image.
The document must be saved as a PDF file.
The document must use heading styles for sections.
The document must have a cover page inserted.
The document must use a specific font size.
qs.e: Word generates the TOC by identifying paragraphs formatted with heading styles.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: In MS Word, a user wants to change the orientation of a single page to landscape. How is this achieved?
o: Changing the page setup for the entire document.
Using the Zoom feature to adjust the view.
Rotating the text box containing the content.
Inserting section breaks and changing orientation.
Deleting the page and reinserting it in landscape.
qs.e: Section breaks allow different page orientations to coexist within a single document.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: In MS Word, a user wants to insert a header that appears on every page. How is this done?
o: Typing text directly into the top margin area.
Using the 'Page Layout' tab to modify margins.
Using the 'Insert' tab and selecting 'Header'.
Using the 'References' tab and adding a note.
Using the 'View' tab and enabling the ruler.
qs.e: Headers are inserted via the Insert tab and repeat on every page by default.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: In MS Word, a user wants to ensure that a long table does not split across pages. Which feature should be adjusted?
o: Keep with next paragraph option in paragraph formatting settings
Allow row to break across pages option in table properties
Repeat header rows option in table layout configuration options
Fit to window option in layout page setup formatting settings
Lock anchor option in floating object position configuration settings
qs.e: Unchecking 'Allow row to break across pages' prevents individual table rows from splitting between sheets.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - October 30, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: A user in MS Word wants to create a table of contents that updates automatically as the document changes. What is required?
o: Utilizing footnote citations to link document section headings to body text
Manually entering page numbers for each individual structural section heading
Inserting manual page breaks immediately prior to major document chapter sections
Applying built-in heading styles to structural section titles in the document
Formatting the entire document content using a single continuous column layout
qs.e: Automatic tables of contents rely on built-in heading styles to identify and list document sections.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: ICT Exam - October 30, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)
